details.name: Determining When a Customer Could Rent a Car (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether a customer could rent a car based on the inputs that it receives from the car rental agent. Rental cars are available to licensed drivers of 21 years of age or over.

details.name: Determining When a Customer Could Rent a Car (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether a customer could rent a car based on the inputs that it receives from the car rental agent. Rental cars are available to licensed drivers of 21 years of age or over who have not had a car accident.

details.name: Determining When a Customer Could Rent a Car (Case 3)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether a customer could rent a car based on the inputs that it receives from the car rental agent. Rental cars are available to licensed drivers who are either at least 21 years old or have a credit card with $10,000 or more of credit.
